verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm that offers legal consultations and visa or permanent-residency services, not a software product. Asking whether it ships an official CLI is a category error for a professional legal-services provider. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any CLI or developer tooling that would make the axis apply, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
